recipe: team-centric: d = my score - opponent score, t = share of game left (0..1), poss = +1 my ball, -1 their ball, 0 unknown, pre = logit of my pre-game win chance; z1 = d/sqrt(t+0.02); features = [z1, d, pre, pre*t, pre*sqrt(t), poss, poss*t, poss*sqrt(t)]; p = sigmoid(coef . features)
